tools.name: create_content_draft
tools.description: Create a new content draft for blog posts or social media. Returns the draft ID for subsequent operations. Pass externalRef to make the create idempotent — re-runs return the existing draft instead of duplicating. LinkedIn notes (platform "linkedin"): the excerpt is the post commentary (max 3000 chars) — write it as plain text and NEVER pre-escape LinkedIn reserved characters ((){}<>[]*_~|@#\), the publisher escapes server-side; LinkedIn has no native scheduling or drafts, so IP Bot holds the draft and publishes at the scheduled time; the destinationConfig is validated against the shared LinkedIn contract before the draft is created and specific error messages are returned; author defaults to the connected member (authorType "member") — organization posting needs authorType "organization" + accountId (org id), LinkedIn Community Management API approval, and a posting Page role; LinkedIn has NO organic carousels — use imageUrls (2–20 images) for a multi-image post.

excerpt.description: Excerpt or social media caption (the IG/FB caption — preferred over body)

destinationConfig.description: Platform-specific config (igAccountId+imageUrl for IG, pageId for FB, siteId for WP). For image posts also supports altText (single image) and mediaAltTexts (array parallel to mediaUrls for carousels) — accessible descriptions published as IG alt_text / FB alt_text_custom. Carousel note: Instagram derives the carousel aspect ratio from the FIRST child in mediaUrls and crops every other child to match it. LinkedIn config (exactly ONE content group; all optional → text post): authorType "member" (default) | "organization" (+ accountId org id — requires Community Management approval and a posting Page role); visibility PUBLIC (default) | CONNECTIONS (member-only) | LOGGED_IN; imageUrl+altText (single image) OR imageUrls (2–20) + altTexts (paired by index — LinkedIn has no organic carousels, multi-image is the equivalent) OR videoUrl (+videoThumbnailUrl, captionsUrl) OR documentUrl+documentTitle (title REQUIRED — renders as the document name) OR article {source, title (REQUIRED — LinkedIn does not scrape link metadata), description?, thumbnailUrl?} OR poll {question ≤140, options 2–4 (≤30 chars each), duration ONE_DAY|THREE_DAYS|SEVEN_DAYS|FOURTEEN_DAYS} OR reshareOfUrn (urn:li:share:… / urn:li:ugcPost:…). Extras: firstComment (posted right after publish), targetEntities (org authors only, needs >300 matching followers).

altText.description: Accessible image description (a11y). ALWAYS provide for image posts — merged into destinationConfig.altText and published as Instagram alt_text / Facebook alt_text_custom. Describe what the image shows, not the caption.

mediaAltTexts.description: Per-carousel-child alt text, paired by index with destinationConfig.mediaUrls. Accessibility-critical — omitting it drops alt text silently. Images only (not Reels/Stories). Merged into destinationConfig.mediaAltTexts.

locationId.description: Instagram location_id / Facebook place — ALWAYS consider for venue/event posts; boosts local discovery

collaborators.description: IG usernames for a co-author invite on reels/carousels; post appears on both profiles (suggest the featured accounts — the people, brands, or partners the post is about)

userTags.description: Tag people in the media (images need x/y 0..1; reels/stories username only)

coverUrl.description: Reels presentation: custom cover image URL for the reel

thumbOffset.description: Reels presentation: cover frame offset in milliseconds into the video (alternative to coverUrl)

audioName.description: Reels presentation: rename the original audio track shown on the reel

shareToFeed.description: Reels presentation: also surface the reel in the main feed/profile grid

story.description: Publish as an Instagram STORY (no caption/alt; image or video)

placeId.description: Facebook page-post: place/location ID attached to the page post (check-in style)

callToAction.description: Facebook page-post: call-to-action object {type, value:{link}} — e.g. {type:"BUY_TICKETS", value:{link:"https://..."}}

targeting.description: Facebook page-post: audience RESTRICTION (limits who can see the post, e.g. {age_min:21}) — REQUIRED for 21+ compliance content like alcohol/nightlife promotions

feedTargeting.description: Facebook page-post: feed prioritization (who is more likely to see it in feed, without restricting visibility)

backdatedTime.description: Facebook page-post: ISO 8601 timestamp to backdate the post into the page timeline

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; required under API-key auth — the call errors (BAD_REQUEST) if neither is set.

externalRef.description: Idempotency key (e.g. "MF5S-177:cell-1"). If a draft with this key already exists, returns it instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: submit_for_review
tools.description: Submit a draft for human review. Transitions draft from "draft" to "submitted" status. Optionally posts a Jira comment to `notifyJira` (e.g. "MF5S-177") with the draft preview and an `ipbot content approve` snippet — requires ATLASSIAN_SITE/EMAIL/API_TOKEN env vars or ~/.ipbot/jira.json.

notifyJira.description: Jira issue key to comment on after submit

tools.name: approve_draft
tools.description: Approve a submitted draft. Transitions from "submitted" to "approved" status. IBD-204b: rejects self-review (reviewer == draft author) unless allowSelfReview=true; agents driving the full pipeline as a single actor should pass allowSelfReview=true.

allowSelfReview.description: Permit reviewing your own draft (single-actor agent flows)

tools.name: reject_draft
tools.description: Reject a submitted draft. Transitions from "submitted" to "rejected" status. IBD-204b: rejects self-review unless allowSelfReview=true.

allowSelfReview.description: Permit reviewing your own draft (single-actor agent flows)

tools.name: schedule_publication
tools.description: Schedule an approved draft for publication. `scheduledAt` accepts ISO 8601 (2026-05-30T00:50:00Z) or natural language ("in 10 minutes", "fri 7pm ET", "2026-05-29 17:50 America/Los_Angeles"). When the input omits a timezone, the optional `tz` argument fills it in (IANA name or US abbreviation). Returns the resolved UTC ISO under `_scheduledAt` so callers can confirm what the parser picked. Works for every platform including LinkedIn — LinkedIn has no native scheduling, so IP Bot holds the draft and publishes at the scheduled time. Optionally posts a Jira comment to `notifyJira` with scheduleId / scheduledAt / dest + a `ipbot calendar wait` snippet.

scheduledAt.description: When to publish — ISO 8601 or natural language

tz.description: Default timezone if scheduledAt has no explicit zone (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles" or "PT")

notifyJira.description: Jira issue key to comment on after scheduling

tools.name: publish_now
tools.description: Immediately publish an approved draft to its target platform.

tools.name: cancel_schedule
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled publication. Reverts the draft back to "approved" status.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload a local image (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 8 MB) or video (MP4/MOV, max 200 MB) to the platform S3 media bucket and get back a publicly fetchable URL to use on drafts / destinationConfig.imageUrl. Native replacement for external hosts like catbox.moe. Requires an identity-bound caller (Cognito or per-user ipbot_live key); the shared AppSync key is rejected.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local image/video file

tools.name: reschedule_schedule
tools.description: Move a scheduled publication to a new time. Only works while the schedule status is "scheduled" (not executing/completed/cancelled). Auth restriction: requires a Cognito identity or a per-user ipbot_live API key — the shared AppSync API key gets Unauthorized. `scheduledAt` accepts ISO 8601 or natural language; the optional `tz` fills in a missing timezone. Returns the resolved UTC ISO under `_scheduledAt`.

scheduledAt.description: New publish time — ISO 8601 or natural language

tz.description: Default timezone if scheduledAt has no explicit zone (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles" or "PT")

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List content drafts filtered by status. Returns draft summaries.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Get full details of a content draft including body, attachments, and config.

tools.name: show_calendar
tools.description: Show scheduled and completed publications. Returns items grouped by date.

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; required under API-key auth — the call errors (BAD_REQUEST) if neither is set.

tools.name: create_content_post
tools.description: Create ONE cross-platform post (ContentPost) fanned out to N per-platform draft parts. This is the PRIMARY way to publish one piece of media + story across multiple platforms with per-platform caption/config overrides — prefer it over create_content_draft whenever targeting 2+ platforms. Shared media/baseCaption/tags live on the post; each part carries its platform voice (caption) and API flavor (destinationConfig, merged over the shared media — part keys win). Pass externalRef for idempotency: re-runs return the existing post (existing:true) with the same postId and part draftIds. Returns { success, postId, status, drafts: [{draftId, platform}] }. LinkedIn parts get authorType "member" by default and are validated pre-flight against the shared LinkedIn contract (specific errors returned before anything is created). LinkedIn captions: max 3000 chars, plain text — never pre-escape reserved characters, the publisher escapes server-side. LinkedIn has no native scheduling/drafts (IP Bot schedules) and no organic carousels (use imageUrls 2–20 on the part).

title.description: Post title (shared across parts; required for blog parts)

baseCaption.description: Default caption for every part (a part's caption overrides it)

media.description: Shared media object: {imageUrl?, videoUrl?, mediaUrls?, mediaAltTexts?, altText?, coverUrl?}

imageUrl.description: Single-image URL shared by all parts

videoUrl.description: Video URL shared by all parts (reels/video posts)

mediaUrls.description: Carousel media URLs (order matters — IG derives the carousel aspect ratio from the FIRST child)

mediaAltTexts.description: Per-carousel-child alt text, paired by index with mediaUrls (a11y — omitting drops alt text silently)

altText.description: Accessible image description (a11y). ALWAYS provide for image posts — published as IG alt_text / FB alt_text_custom

platform.description: Target platform for this part: instagram | facebook | wordpress | linkedin | hubspot_blog

caption.description: Per-platform caption override (defaults to the post baseCaption)

type.description: Part content type override: social_post | blog

destinationConfig.description: Per-platform config (igAccountId for IG, pageId for FB, siteId for WP, plus locationId/collaborators/story/targeting/...). Keys merge OVER the shared media object — part wins. LinkedIn parts: authorType member (default) | organization (+ accountId; needs Community Management approval + page role), visibility, ONE content group (imageUrl+altText | imageUrls 2–20 + altTexts — no organic carousels | videoUrl | documentUrl+documentTitle | article{source,title,…} | poll{question,options,duration} | reshareOfUrn), firstComment, targetEntities (org only). Validated against the shared LinkedIn contract before the API call.

parts.description: Per-platform parts (min 1) — one ContentDraft is created per part

organizationId.description: Organization scope for the post and its parts

teamId.description: Team scope for the post and its parts

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; under Cognito auth the backend derives it from the caller identity.

externalRef.description: Idempotency key (e.g. "MF5S-201:launch"). Replays return the existing post with existing:true instead of duplicating.

tools.name: get_content_post
tools.description: Get a cross-platform post (ContentPost) with its per-platform draft parts inlined. Returns { success, post, drafts }.

tools.name: list_content_posts
tools.description: List cross-platform posts (ContentPost wrappers) for a user, newest first, optionally filtered by rollup status (draft|submitted|approved|scheduled|published|partial|failed).

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; required under API-key auth — the call errors (BAD_REQUEST) if neither is set.

tools.name: submit_post_for_review
tools.description: Submit every draft part of a cross-platform post for review in one action (post-level equivalent of submit_for_review). Returns { success, postId, status, results }.

tools.name: approve_post
tools.description: Approve every submitted part of a cross-platform post in one action. Same self-review gate as approve_draft (IBD-204b): rejects reviewer == author unless allowSelfReview=true; single-actor agent flows should pass allowSelfReview=true.

allowSelfReview.description: Permit reviewing your own post (single-actor agent flows)

tools.name: reject_post
tools.description: Reject every submitted part of a cross-platform post in one action. Same self-review gate as reject_draft (IBD-204b): pass allowSelfReview=true for single-actor agent flows.

allowSelfReview.description: Permit reviewing your own post (single-actor agent flows)

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule every approved part of a cross-platform post. One shared ISO 8601 time, with optional per-platform overrides via platformTimes (e.g. IG at peak time, the blog at 9am — platforms missing from the map use scheduledAt). Returns { success, postId, status, results: [{draftId, platform, scheduleId, scheduledAt|error}] }.

tools.name: publish_post_now
tools.description: Immediately publish every approved part of a cross-platform post (schedule_post with now).

tools.name: cancel_post_schedules
tools.description: Cancel every still-scheduled part publication of a cross-platform post (scheduled parts revert to approved).

postId.description: Post ID whose schedules to cancel

tools.name: create_organization
tools.description: Create a new organization ("Your Own Crew"). Returns org ID and owner membership.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Invite a user to an organization by email. Requires admin or owner role.

tools.name: accept_invite
tools.description: Accept an organization invitation using the invite token.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member from an organization. Requires admin or owner role.

tools.name: update_member_role
tools.description: Change a member's role in an organization.

tools.name: update_organization
tools.description: Update organization settings (name, description, default brand voice). Owners and admins only. `voice` is the organization's default in the existing voice system (IBD-647), the same fields as a person's Brand Voice: {tone, writingStyle, vocabularyLevel, preferredPhrases[], avoidedPhrases[], sampleContent[], voiceCharacteristics:{…free-form, e.g. summary, do[], dont[]}} — all keys optional, unknown keys refused (colours and fonts go in brandConfig); it REPLACES the stored default; null clears it. Per-account overrides are the Voice profiles edited at /voice. get_org_context returns the resolved voice as org.voice.

voice.description: Default brand voice (replaces the stored one); null clears it

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the caller belongs to (with role + status). Use this to DISCOVER an organizationId before calling get_org_context / list_org_drafts.

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; errors (BAD_REQUEST) if neither is set.

tools.name: get_org_context
tools.description: Get full organization context including members, pending invites, your role, and the brand voice to write in. org.voice = {tone, writingStyle, vocabularyLevel, preferredPhrases[], avoidedPhrases[], sampleContent[], voiceCharacteristics?} or null; org.voiceSource says where it came from: "account" (the organization default with the overlay of the connected publishing point named by `destination` applied: blank overlay fields keep the default, set text changes it, lists add; org.voiceAccountRef names the publishing point and org.voiceOverlay holds only what it sets itself, e.g. platform format rules in voiceCharacteristics.do/dont), "org" (the organization default), "owner" (the owner's own Brand Voice) or "none". ALWAYS pass `destination` when you know where the words will be published. A platform name with more than one overlay applies none and lists them in org.voiceAmbiguous — call again with one of those accountRefs.

destination.description: Where the words will be published: an accountRef ("meta:ig:<igAccountId>", "meta:fb:<pageId>", "li:org:<id>", "hs:blog:<id>") or a platform ("instagram", "facebook", "linkedin", "hubspot", "blog")

tools.name: get_org_audit
tools.description: Read an organization's audit log (who did what, when). Verifies caller is an org member.

tools.name: list_org_drafts
tools.description: List content drafts for an organization. Verifies caller is an org member.

tools.name: share_account
tools.description: Share a specific account (e.g., one Instagram account) with an organization so the team and agents can publish to it.

provider.description: Provider: meta | google | wordpress | linkedin | hubspot

accountId.description: Account ID (e.g., IG business account ID)

tools.name: unshare_account
tools.description: Remove a specific shared account from an organization.

sharedAccountId.description: Shared account record ID to remove

tools.name: create_review_share
tools.description: Create a tokenized review link for a draft so someone NOT on the platform can view it and offer revision information (comment / approve / reject / request changes). Returns { shareId, token, url }. Send the url to the reviewer; they open it without logging in.

draftId.description: Draft ID to share for review

recipientName.description: Reviewer name (shown on the public review page)

recipientEmail.description: Reviewer email (for the owner’s records, and the address emailed if sendEmail=true)

sendEmail.description: If true and recipientEmail is set, email the link via SES (best-effort). Response includes emailSent / emailError.

allowedActions.description: What the link permits. Defaults to all (view+comment+approve+reject+request_changes). "view" is always implied.

tools.name: list_review_shares
tools.description: List the tokenized review links for a draft, including status, recipient, allowed actions, view count, and any captured decision.

tools.name: revoke_review_share
tools.description: Revoke a review link so its token can no longer be used.

tools.name: add_review_comment
tools.description: Add an internal comment or approval note to a draft. Shown in the review thread alongside external reviewer feedback.

tools.name: list_review_comments
tools.description: List the comments and notes on a draft (internal + external reviewer feedback), oldest first.

tools.name: get_post_insights
tools.description: Get cached performance metrics (likes, comments, shares, reach, impressions, saves, views, engagement) for a published post. Pass the schedule's platformPostId + the draft's platform. For LinkedIn the platformPostId is the post URN exactly as returned by the schedule — urn:li:share:<id> or urn:li:ugcPost:<id> — pass it through verbatim, colons and all. Set refresh:true to request an on-demand poll — it returns the cached snapshot immediately and triggers a background fetch when the snapshot is stale. Read `fetchedAt` for freshness.

platformPostId.description: Platform-native post id (PublicationSchedule.platformPostId). LinkedIn: the full URN, urn:li:share:… or urn:li:ugcPost:…

platform.description: Platform the post was published to (instagram|facebook|linkedin)

refresh.description: Request an on-demand refresh when the cache is stale (default false)

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List connected social accounts for a user. Provider "meta" (default): IG handles + FB pages, resolving @username → igAccountId for content-pipeline destinationConfig. Provider "linkedin": one member identity row plus one row per organization (accountId pairs with the LinkedIn destinationConfig accountId; role shows the page role; health "reconnect_needed" means the token expired/was revoked and the user must reconnect). Reads OAuthConnection.metadata.accounts[].

userId.description: Cognito sub for the user whose accounts to list

tools.name: find_draft_by_external_ref
tools.description: Find an existing draft by its idempotency key (extref:<key> tag). Returns the draft if found, or {found: false}. Used to make agent flows safe to re-run.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get a single publication schedule entry with its terminal-state details (publishedUrl, platformPostId, error).

tools.name: schedule_debug
tools.description: Diagnose a publication schedule: pulls schedule + draft state, tails recent content-publisher Lambda logs filtered on draftId, and returns {status, lastError: {category, suggestedFix, raw}, errorContext, draft}. lastError.category is a stable enum (missing_dest_config, ig_container_failed, fb_token_expired, fb_missing_scope, fb_page_not_found, fb_rate_limited, fb_unsupported_post_type, fb_temporary_failure, image_unfetchable, unknown) — agents can branch on it without regexing the raw message. Requires AWS credentials with cloudwatch logs:FilterLogEvents permission on the publisher log group.

sinceMs.description: How far back to scan logs in ms (default 1 hour)

logGroupName.description: Override the publisher log group (env: IPBOT_PUBLISHER_LOG_GROUP)

tools.name: draft_from_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a Jira ticket, parse "## Cell N — <theme>" sections, resolve @handle → IG/page IDs, and create one draft per cell × platform with extref:<KEY>:<cell-id>:<platform> for idempotency. Cell fields: **Image:** (required for IG/FB cells; repeatable — 2+ become a LinkedIn multi-image post), **Alt:** (accessible image description — include it in every content ticket; published as IG alt_text / FB alt_text_custom / LinkedIn altText), **scheduledAt:** (optional). LinkedIn-only markers: **Video:**, **Document:** + **DocumentTitle:**, **Article:** + **ArticleTitle:**/**ArticleDescription:**, **Poll:** + **PollOptions:** (CSV) + **PollDuration:**, **LinkedInOrg:** (org author — preamble applies to all cells, per-cell wins), **FirstComment:**. LinkedIn cells are validated against the shared contract at parse time; failures land in the cell errors. Re-runs return existing drafts. Pass dryRun=true to preview the plan as JSON without creating drafts. Requires Jira credentials via ATLASSIAN_SITE/EMAIL/API_TOKEN env vars or ~/.ipbot/jira.json.

userId.description: Cognito sub whose OAuth connection resolves @handle → IG/page IDs

platforms.description: Limit to specific platforms (default: every platform present in the ticket)

dryRun.description: Print the plan as JSON without creating drafts

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Pre-flight health snapshot for the publishing system: publisher Lambda (state/runtime/lastModified), publisher EventBridge rule (state/scheduleExpression/invocations in last hour), AppSync (synthetic ping latency), and OAuthConnections expiring within `days` (default 7). Returns `overallHealth` ∈ {ok, warn, fail, unknown}. Requires read-only AWS IAM: lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, events:ListRules, cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics.

rulePrefix.description: Override EventBridge rule name prefix (env: IPBOT_PUBLISHER_RULE_PREFIX)

tools.name: wait_for_schedule
tools.description: Block until a schedule reaches a terminal state (completed / failed / cancelled). Returns the final schedule record. Polls every pollSeconds; returns {…, _timedOut: true} on timeout. Optionally posts a Jira comment to `notifyJira` with the terminal outcome (publishedUrl + post ID on success, error + `schedule debug` snippet on failure).

notifyJira.description: Jira issue key to comment on with terminal outcome

tools.name: list_powers
tools.description: List the runnable IP Bot Powers with their per-Power Winds cost, category, required connectors, and paid-only flag. Use this to discover what the agent can run before calling run_power. Also available as the resource ipbot://powers/catalog.

tools.name: run_power
tools.description: Run an IP Bot Power, metered against the authenticated caller's Winds (pre-flight → debit → run → refund-on-failure — you only pay for successful runs). Returns the Power result, or {success:false, error:{code}} where code ∈ INSUFFICIENT_WINDS (with windsCost/balance/shortBy) | PAID_ONLY | UNKNOWN_POWER | UNAUTHENTICATED | BAD_REQUEST. Requires a per-user API key or Cognito token (the shared API key has no user). Writer Powers generate through the shared ContextEnvelope (brand voice + post/thread context; user text delimited as untrusted): power-instagram-comment-reply results carry per-reply contextSource (draft|graph|none) + threadLength and a skips[] list (reason 'no-context-no-template' — with zero meaningful context and no template the comment is skipped, never bare-prompted); power-dm-trigger-response responses carry viaTemplate + threadLength.

teamId.description: Run in a team context (requires canRunPowers on the team)

accountRef.description: Account to act on, "{provider}:{accountId}" (must be assigned to the team if teamId is set)

tools.name: get_winds_balance
tools.description: Get the authenticated caller's current Winds balance: weekly remaining, weekly allowance, à-la-carte balance, and the current period key. Use before run_power to check affordability. Also available as the resource ipbot://winds/economy (which explains the model). Requires a per-user API key or Cognito token.

tools.name: topup_winds
tools.description: Start a Stripe Checkout session to buy an à-la-carte Winds pack (never expires). Returns JSON with a checkout URL to open. Packs: small | medium | large. Requires a per-user API key or Cognito token.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create an AutoReply campaign (created as a draft — activate with set_campaign_status). Steps run in sequence after a trigger. AI-generated replies are context-aware: the LLM sees the post caption, what the images show (their alt text), and the comment thread so far — one more reason alt text is mandatory at publish time. Meta rules: DM steps triggered by a comment send a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment. Free-form DMs require the user to have messaged within 24h. HUMAN_AGENT is never used by automation.

accountRef.description: Account to route on: "meta:ig:<igAccountId>" | "meta:fb:<pageId>". Required for the webhook to deliver events to this campaign.

platform.description: Platform (derived from accountRef when set; default instagram)

triggerOn.description: Interaction kinds that trigger the campaign (default ["comment"])

triggerKeywords.description: Keyword filters for comments — the campaign fires only when the comment contains one (ignored when triggerAllComments=true)

triggerAllComments.description: Trigger on every comment regardless of keywords (default false)

triggerMediaIds.description: Restrict triggering to these IG media IDs; empty = all media. Inbound DMs carry no mediaId and are never media-filtered.

steps.description: Ordered message steps (comment reply, DM, email)

stepIndex.description: Position in the sequence (0-based; defaults to array order)

type.description: Step action. "dm" triggered by a comment sends a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment.

delayMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after the trigger before executing this step

prompt.description: LLM prompt when useAI=true. Supports {{username}} and {{comment_text}} placeholders. The LLM already sees the post caption, image alt text, and the comment thread so far (ContextEnvelope) — write the prompt to steer tone/intent, not to restate the post.

useAI.description: Generate the message with the LLM (default true). Set false to send staticMessage verbatim.

link.description: Generic link for DM steps (fallback when no segment matches); message supports {{link}}

tag.description: Contact tag this variant targets (first matching tag wins)

cooldownMinutes.description: Min minutes between actions to the same user (default 5)

replyToReplies.description: Controls engagement with comment replies (comments nested under a top-level comment). 'when-addressed' (recommended): reply only when the reply mentions or addresses the account (LLM-classified). 'never': engage top-level comments only. Absent = 'always' (legacy). All policies get one engagement per user per thread; replies are generated with thread context (the conversation so far) plus the post's caption and image alt text.

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID; required under API-key auth.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List AutoReply campaigns for a user, optionally filtered by status. Returns campaign rows with parsed steps.

userId.description: User ID (Cognito sub). Falls back to IPBOT_USER_ID.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Get full details of an AutoReply campaign including triggers, media scoping, and parsed steps.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Update an AutoReply campaign (partial — only provided fields change). Changing accountRef re-derives routing ids and webhookActive. Set replyToReplies to control engagement with nested comment replies ('when-addressed' recommended; unset = 'always', legacy). Meta rules: DM steps triggered by a comment send a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment. Free-form DMs require the user to have messaged within 24h.

triggerOn.description: Interaction kinds that trigger the campaign (default ["comment"])

triggerKeywords.description: Keyword filters for comments — the campaign fires only when the comment contains one (ignored when triggerAllComments=true)

triggerAllComments.description: Trigger on every comment regardless of keywords (default false)

triggerMediaIds.description: Restrict triggering to these IG media IDs; empty = all media. Inbound DMs carry no mediaId and are never media-filtered.

stepIndex.description: Position in the sequence (0-based; defaults to array order)

type.description: Step action. "dm" triggered by a comment sends a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment.

delayMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after the trigger before executing this step

prompt.description: LLM prompt when useAI=true. Supports {{username}} and {{comment_text}} placeholders. The LLM already sees the post caption, image alt text, and the comment thread so far (ContextEnvelope) — write the prompt to steer tone/intent, not to restate the post.

useAI.description: Generate the message with the LLM (default true). Set false to send staticMessage verbatim.

link.description: Generic link for DM steps (fallback when no segment matches); message supports {{link}}

tag.description: Contact tag this variant targets (first matching tag wins)

cooldownMinutes.description: Min minutes between actions to the same user

replyToReplies.description: Controls engagement with comment replies (comments nested under a top-level comment). 'when-addressed' (recommended): reply only when the reply mentions or addresses the account (LLM-classified). 'never': engage top-level comments only. Absent = 'always' (legacy). All policies get one engagement per user per thread; replies are generated with thread context (the conversation so far) plus the post's caption and image alt text.

tools.name: set_campaign_status
tools.description: Activate, pause, or archive an AutoReply campaign. webhookActive flips in lockstep: activate enables webhook routing (when the campaign has a routable accountRef), pause/archive stops all sends.

tools.name: set_campaign_steps
tools.description: Replace the full message-step sequence of an AutoReply campaign. AI (prompt) steps generate context-rich replies: the LLM sees the post caption, image alt text, and the comment thread so far. Meta rules: a DM step triggered by a comment sends a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment; the executor suppresses violations (private_reply_already_sent / private_reply_window_expired).

stepIndex.description: Position in the sequence (0-based; defaults to array order)

type.description: Step action. "dm" triggered by a comment sends a private reply — max ONE per comment, within 7 days of the comment.

delayMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after the trigger before executing this step

prompt.description: LLM prompt when useAI=true. Supports {{username}} and {{comment_text}} placeholders. The LLM already sees the post caption, image alt text, and the comment thread so far (ContextEnvelope) — write the prompt to steer tone/intent, not to restate the post.

useAI.description: Generate the message with the LLM (default true). Set false to send staticMessage verbatim.

link.description: Generic link for DM steps (fallback when no segment matches); message supports {{link}}

tag.description: Contact tag this variant targets (first matching tag wins)

steps.description: Ordered message steps (replaces the existing sequence)

tools.name: set_campaign_triggers
tools.description: Update only the trigger configuration of an AutoReply campaign (kinds, keywords, all-comments flag, media scoping). Pass clearMediaIds=true to remove media scoping and trigger on all media again.

triggerOn.description: Interaction kinds that trigger the campaign (default ["comment"])

triggerKeywords.description: Keyword filters for comments — the campaign fires only when the comment contains one (ignored when triggerAllComments=true)

triggerAllComments.description: Trigger on every comment regardless of keywords (default false)

triggerMediaIds.description: Restrict triggering to these IG media IDs; empty = all media. Inbound DMs carry no mediaId and are never media-filtered.

clearMediaIds.description: Clear triggerMediaIds (back to triggering on all media). Wins over triggerMediaIds if both are passed.

tools.name: attach_knowledge_source
tools.description: Attach a Google Drive shared folder as brand knowledge and sync it immediately. The sync reads text files, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, PDFs and small images, and writes what it finds into the knowledge store every content generator already reads — so the folder's material shapes the next caption, reply or blog draft with no further setup. Returns the sync outcome including anything it deliberately skipped and why.

folderUrl.description: Google Drive folder share link or bare folder id, e.g. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>

name.description: Display name (defaults to the folder's own name)

syncIntervalHours.description: Hours between automatic re-syncs; 0 disables automatic sync (default 24)

accountRef.description: Bind this folder to one voice (e.g. "meta:ig:<igAccountId>" or "meta:fb:<pageId>"); omit for brand-wide knowledge shared by every voice

tools.name: list_knowledge_sources
tools.description: List attached knowledge sources with their sync state, asset counts, and the summary/error from the last sync.

userId.description: User ID (required for API key auth)

tools.name: sync_knowledge_source
tools.description: Re-walk an attached folder now, picking up added, changed and deleted files. Use after editing the folder rather than waiting for the scheduled sync.

tools.name: detach_knowledge_source
tools.description: Detach a folder and delete every knowledge asset it produced. The folder itself is untouched; only IP Bot's copy is removed.

tools.name: list_knowledge_assets
tools.description: List the knowledge assets a generator will actually see, optionally narrowed to one knowledge source. Use this when generated content looks wrong and you need to know what is in the knowledge base.

sourceId.description: Only assets synced from this knowledge source

accountRef.description: Only assets bound to this voice (e.g. "meta:ig:<id>")

userId.description: User ID (required for API key auth)

tools.name: get_knowledge_asset
tools.description: Read one knowledge asset's extracted text — literally what the model sees for that file. The first thing to check when a draft reflects a document incorrectly, since PDF and image text is model-extracted and can be wrong.

tools.name: list_escalations
tools.description: List customer conversations waiting on a HUMAN reply — DMs the automation could not answer before the 24h standard messaging window closed. Each row carries hoursLeftInWindow: hours remaining in the 7-day escalation window before the conversation can no longer be answered at all. Use this to triage what a person needs to respond to.

status.description: Event status to list (default "window_expired" — the escalation queue)

tools.name: send_human_agent_reply
tools.description: Send a reply a HUMAN wrote to an escalated conversation. Past the 24h window the backend attaches Meta's HUMAN_AGENT tag, which formally asserts that a person — not software — composed this message; inside 24h it sends untagged. DO NOT compose the message yourself: pass through text a human gave you, verbatim. An AI-written body sent under this tag is a Meta Platform Policy violation and puts the app's API access at risk. The send is recorded against the operator's user id as an audit trail.

message.description: The reply text, written by a human. Max 1000 UTF-8 bytes. Never model-generated.

userId.description: User ID (required for API key auth)
